# GitHub Copilot Custom Instructions

All Copilot sessions must strictly follow `AGENTS.md` (Vault root `AGENTS.md` or `~/.gemini/config/AGENTS.md`).

## ⚡ Fast Onboarding (v3.0 Self-Contained First)
1. Priority 1: Read `./AGENTS.md` (<= 50 lines) and `./CONTEXT.md` (<= 60 lines) at the project repository root (`01-Projects/_active/<project>/` for legacy decoupled projects).
2. Priority 2: Load `./SPEC.md` and `./TICKETS.md` only when L2/L3 work requires architecture or task details.
3. Priority 3: Consult `00-AgentOS/GLOSSARY.md` in the Vault for shared terminology.

Always keep `CONTEXT.md` synchronized via `/handoff` after completing changes.
See [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for complete guidelines.
